items.exampleEn: Traditionally, families eat together on the last night of the year.
items.exampleZh: 傳統上，家人會在一年的最後一晚一起吃飯。

items.exampleEn: Old wires can be a fire hazard in a house.
items.exampleZh: 老舊電線可能造成住家的火災危險。

items.exampleEn: Economic news is on TV every evening.
items.exampleZh: 每天晚上電視上都有經濟新聞。

items.exampleEn: She wants to work in the music industry.
Students learn how the economy works.
items.exampleZh: 學生學習經濟如何運作。

items.exampleEn: Ancient Athens had a democratic system.
items.exampleZh: 古代雅典有民主的制度。

items.exampleEn: The town has many religious buildings, such as temples and churches.
items.exampleZh: 這個小鎮有很多宗教建築，例如寺廟和教堂。

items.exampleEn: There are big cultural differences between the two countries.
items.exampleZh: 這兩個國家之間有很大的文化差異。

items.exampleEn: The singer is a global star.

items.sentenceEn: The festival has a long cultural history.
items.sentenceZh: 這個節慶有悠久的文化歷史。

items.audioEn: Warning: the path by the river is a hazard after heavy rain, so please use the road.
items.audioZh: 注意：大雨過後河邊的小路很危險，請走大路。
options: The river path is being repaired today.
The road is much shorter than the path.
The road has more shops and cafés.

items.sentenceEn: This dance is traditionally performed at weddings.
items.sentenceZh: 這種舞蹈傳統上會在婚禮上表演。

items.sentenceEn: Global sales of the phone went up this year.
items.sentenceZh: 這款手機的全球銷量今年上升了。

items.stemEn: Many ____ companies sell their products in more than fifty countries.
items.stemZh: 許多跨國公司在五十多個國家販售產品。

items.stemEn: The car ____ in this city has created thousands of jobs.
items.stemZh: 這座城市的汽車工業創造了好幾千個工作機會。

items.passageEn: Our town traditionally holds a rice festival every autumn. It is a cultural and religious event: people visit the temple to give thanks for the harvest. The festival is also important for the local economy, because visitors spend money in shops and hotels. In recent years, the tourism industry here has grown, and the festival now gets global attention. The economic benefits are clear. This year, the town made a democratic decision about the festival date: every resident could vote. The town also warned visitors about one hazard: the old bridge is not safe in strong wind.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上傳統上每年秋天都會舉辦稻米節。這是一個文化性也是宗教性的活動：人們會到廟裡感謝豐收。這個節慶對當地經濟也很重要，因為遊客會在商店和旅館消費。近年來，這裡的觀光業成長了，節慶現在也受到全球關注。經濟上的好處很明顯。今年，鎮上用民主的方式決定節慶日期：每位居民都可以投票。鎮上也提醒遊客注意一個危險：強風時舊橋不安全。

questions.questionZh: 這個節慶為什麼對當地經濟很重要？
options: 政府每年給小鎮一筆補助
外地的工廠會來這裡投資
遊客在商店和旅館消費

questions.questionZh: 鎮上怎麼決定節慶的日期？

items.promptZh: 這座城市的經濟狀況正在好轉。
referenceEn: The city's economic situation is getting better.
The economic situation of the city is improving.
rubricZh: economic 表示「經濟的」，放在名詞前，例如 economic situation 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在進行式 is getting better、is improving 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 global 造一個句子，說說一個你覺得是全球性的問題或現象。
referenceEn: I think plastic waste is a global problem.
I believe clean water is a global need.
rubricZh: global 表示「全球的、全世界的」，例如 a global problem 等說法
說的是自己的看法（例如 I think）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
